beer_name: Craft Nation Hop on the Bandwagon
beer_description: Floral and zesty flavours of tropical fruits with Mosaic and Yellow Sub hops, yet smooth and creamy. Biscuit malt gives it a warm, bready flavour with hints of caramel. This triple hopped beer is a hop lover’s dream. With 7.8% alcohol, our amber coloured Imperial IPA packs a bitter punch. Tasty ‘till the bitter end!
